verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented Pipedream feature for throttling, concurrency limits, or queuing workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits. Automatic retries on errors are a related but different capability. The community-reported inbound HTTP trigger rate limit of 10 req/s is a platform-imposed cap, not a developer-configurable throttle.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
